description: Rejections asserted by the TS tests (engine.test.ts, review-regressions.test.ts; reconcile.test.ts asserts none), one scenario per test: the test’s calls in order on books built as the test builds them, accepted calls as setup (result and delta) and each rejected call with the error the engine throws (code, message, issues) and whether the books were left unchanged. Plus the sanitiser’s own rejections (test: null).
